captures.says: The European Commission's DG CONNECT will be at Web Summit from 10 to 12 November, with Executive Vice-President Henna Virkkunen in a fireside chat on Europe's tech sovereignty on Centre Stage on 10 November (11:05). EU masterclasses cover data spaces for SMEs, practical support for building AI in Europe, HaDEA funding and free access to EuroHPC supercomputers; DG GROW (E415), HaDEA (E418) and EuroHPC (E405) have stands in Pavilion 4.
captures.source_title: DigitalEU at Web Summit 2026: supporting businesses and startups to grow and innovate (updated 3 November 2026)

captures.says: The Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO), with the Dutch foreign ministry and embassy in Lisbon, is taking a Dutch delegation to Web Summit, with an NL Lounge, matchmaking, a welcome event on 9 November and a Dutch networking event on 11 November. Registration is closed.
captures.source_title: Web Summit 2026 in Lisbon: Join the Dutch Delegation (RVO)

captures.says: Web Summit's seventh annual Gender in Tech report (27 October 2026) found 84% of respondents report women in leadership at their company, 35% at C-suite level. It also found that half still experience sexism and 42% have considered scaling back or leaving tech.
captures.source_title: Women are leading in tech. So why are so many considering leaving? (Web Summit blog)
